units.source_text: 浮舟不死在家里，此屋中原无不祥之气。

en.t: Ukifune had not died in the house, so there was originally no ominous air about this dwelling.

units.source_text: 但因随从人等都在面前，故薰大将未便入内，

en.t: But because all the attendants were there in front of him, General Kaoru found it inconvenient to go inside,

units.source_text: 命人将架车辕的台搬来当作凳子，坐在边门外面。

en.t: so he had someone bring over the stand used to support the carriage shafts, used it as a stool, and sat outside the side gate.

units.source_text: 但觉样子难看，后来就走到繁木荫处，以苔为茵，暂坐休息。

en.t: Yet he felt that this looked unseemly, and later went to the shade of thick trees, made the moss his mat, and sat there awhile to rest.

units.source_text: 想起今后不会再到这凄凉的地方来，心甚悲伤，便环顾四周，独自吟诗：

en.t: Thinking that he would never again come to this desolate place, he felt deeply sad, looked all around, and recited a poem alone:
